notes.text: Dated Massy le 3.11.1970 and addressed Cher Deligne. The first paragraph asks whether Deligne has finished looking at Rim's SGA 7 VI exposition and, if so, requests it with his comments; otherwise it asks whether and when he intends to look at it.

The writer says Mlle Altazin, who typed Deligne's SGA 4 XVIII exposition, was asked to send it with the manuscript for correction. He asks about receipt and intention to correct, and requests the clean text after correction or if Deligne does not wish to make the corrections. The source spelling is envoyes moi.
